description: 305 Fitness turns cardio into a dance-fueled party. Inspired by Miami nightlife, this live DJ-driven, inclusive dance cardio experience blends HIIT, kickboxing, and choreography into a full-body workout that's as fun as it is effective. Launched in NYC in 2012, 305 has since expanded across the U.S., drawing hundreds of thousands of fans and cultivating a bold, body-positive community.

Apprenta powers smarter workforce pipelines by automating talent program management from onboarding to graduation. With tailored student portals, seamless integration across HR and academic systems, and automated workflow coordination, it eases administrative burdens while improving retention and ROI. Ideal for organizations training for critical roles—from cybersecurity to healthcare—Apprenta ensures the next generation of talent arrives ready to succeed.

With its recent expansion onto Chewy and other major retailers, Oh Norman! is making industry-grade pet products accessible to all pet parents who demand quality and intentionality.
